store_isolation.d2_integration_database_note: C3 W6-F2 and D1 W6C-D2 carried forward together: the PostgreSQL integration suite TRUNCATEs every table it finds and require_test_database() in postgres_common.sh guards only on a _test suffix, which the evidence database also has. The integration database is therefore separate, and unlike D1's it is migrated to head at creation rather than in the release wave.

store_isolation.sandbox_and_scratch_roots: Only COGOS_ARTIFACT_ROOT and COGOS_BACKUP_ROOT are environment-configured. Sandbox and per-command scratch roots are allocated per command under the D2 prefix and are recorded by the wave that creates them; no destructive matrix row exists yet.
store_isolation.read_rule: The development, C3 and D1 pairs are read-only for D2. Every figure taken from them in W0 came from a SQL SELECT or a file read, never through an application service, so no corpus_accesses, memory_accesses or learned_accesses row was written.

evidence_database_provisioning.gap_inherited: No repository command provisioned an evidence database; C1, C2, C3 and D1 each created theirs by hand and recorded it as a deviation (D1 W0-D1, W0-D2).

nosuperuser_finding.measured: cogos_owner is currently rolsuper = true. The script connects as that same owner, so its first run would succeed and silently demote the role, and every later run would abort on the same line with the earlier statements already applied. That is the partial bootstrap S21D2-082 must make unreachable.
nosuperuser_finding.action: postgres_bootstrap_roles.sh was not run and no role was altered. The new provisioning path never touches roles: it requires them to exist and reports the superuser condition instead of acting on it.
nosuperuser_finding.ownership: The bootstrap script's defect belongs to its owner and is not fixed here.

evidence_database_provisioning.provisioning_guard: COGOS_EVIDENCE_DATABASE_PREFIX. A target outside the prefix is refused before any statement runs, so a typo cannot create or touch a database of another sprint.
